Columbus Friday Night Ride

Columbus, OH · Downtown · Social

Columbus Friday Night Ride is a social group ride in Columbus, OH. It rolls every Friday at 7:00 pm from Topiary Park, Town St entrance. About 10–15 miles, party pace, 10–12 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at @cbusfridayride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Columbus Friday Night Ride group ride

A chill Friday social ride from Topiary Park with a playlist. Route and destination get decided by whoever shows up. Bring lights.
